title: #222 Cooperation and Competition
prompt: Some people believe that cooperation is more important than competition. Discuss whether you think cooperation outweighs competition.

promptSegments.text: Some people believe that cooperation is more important than competition.
Discuss whether you think cooperation outweighs competition.

requirements.en: Discuss the important advantages and disadvantages.
requirements.vi: Thảo luận những ưu điểm và nhược điểm quan trọng.
Đưa ra nhận định tổng thể theo yêu cầu.

requirements.en: Support the comparison with relevant examples.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ phần so sánh bằng ví dụ phù hợp.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Cooperation helps people work together to reach shared goals.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Cooperation helps people work together to reach shared goals.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Another reason is that cooperation builds strong relationships between people.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Another reason is that cooperation builds strong relationships between people.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Cooperation is essential for building strong communities and achieving shared goals, as demonstrated by group efforts like building a school.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Cooperation is essential for building strong communities and achieving shared goals, as demonstrated by group efforts like building a school.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Cooperation provides emotional security and support in daily life, exemplified by neighbors helping each other during a natural disaster.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Cooperation provides emotional security and support in daily life, exemplified by neighbors helping each other during a natural disaster.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Cooperation is fundamentally crucial for human progress and societal stability.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Cooperation is fundamentally crucial for human progress and societal stability.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, cooperation fosters stronger interpersonal relationships and emotional well-being.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Furthermore, cooperation fosters stronger interpersonal relationships and emotional well-being.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not list advantages and disadvantages without making the required judgement.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ liệt kê ưu nhược điểm mà quên đưa ra nhận định bắt buộc.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.
